topic: Troubleshooting database connection and user access
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on technical issues with accessing ClickHouse. Initially, the participant reported a `NetworkError: Code: 210` when connecting to various database instances (e.g., clickhouse04.allunite.local:9000), which was initially suspected to be related to VPN status.

Later, the discussion shifted to user credentials and access rights. [me] confirmed that a new, non-admin user account had been created for the participant, providing sufficient but not administrative access. The participant acknowledged receiving the new credentials and planned to test them.
decisions: A new, non-administrative ClickHouse user account was provisioned for the participant.
action_items: Participant will test the newly provided database credentials and access rights.
